#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>

// A lambda passed as a call argument. Its body's control flow is scored
// against the ENCLOSING function -- lizard never splits a lambda into its
// own block the way it does a named nested function.
int sortAndCount(std::vector<int>& v, int threshold) {
    std::sort(v.begin(), v.end(), [](int a, int b) {
        if (a < b) {
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    });
    int count = 0;
    for (int x : v) {
        if (x > threshold && x % 2 == 0) {
            count++;
        }
    }
    return count;
}

// A lambda with an explicit capture list and a trailing return type.
int captureAndReturnType(int base) {
    auto adder = [base](int x) -> int {
        if (x > 0) {
            return base + x;
        }
        return base;
    };
    return adder(1) + adder(-1);
}
